novelty.justification: The claim proposes a new phenomenon and mechanism: an identifiable "commitment point" where belief "crystallizes" during token-by-token reading, with "premature commitment (before the disambiguating/final token is read)" predicting belief–fact errors and causal suppression of the truth direction delaying that commitment. Searches for "LLM belief commitment point token-wise truth direction," "incremental truth probing transformer hidden states," "premature belief commitment garden path language model," and "temporal truth representation intervention" found the closest foundations in Marks and Tegmark's The Geometry of Truth, tuned-lens work on evolving predictions, and LM garden-path/surprisal studies, but these recover static truth structure, trace generic predictions, or study processing difficulty rather than relating pre-disambiguation truth-state stabilization to belief–fact errors; the 2026 Belief Engine instead models explicit multi-turn stance updates. Moving from those works to the claimed predictive relationship and temporally targeted intervention requires a new core relationship rather than a direct transfer, although it remains within established probing and activation-steering paradigms rather than creating a field-wide new measurement paradigm.
